# apple_game_center_app_version (Resource)

Turns Game Center on or off for one App Store version of an app that has `apple_game_center_detail`. A version has one Game Center app version: the resource creates it, or manages the existing one. App Store Connect can't delete it, so destroying the resource leaves it as it is; set `enabled = false` to turn Game Center off for the version. Import it by the App Store version's ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_app_version" "example" {
  app_store_version_id = apple_app_store_version.example.id
  enabled              = true

  # Game Center must be on for the app first.
  depends_on = [apple_game_center_detail.example]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_store_version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version, e.g. `apple_app_store_version.example.id`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Game Center is on for the version.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center app version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_app_version.example
  identity = {
    app_store_version_id = "0b2d4f6a-8c1e-4a3b-9d5f-1e2a3b4c5d6f"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_store_version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_app_version.example 0b2d4f6a-8c1e-4a3b-9d5f-1e2a3b4c5d6f
```
